Lecture notes for **EOSC 555B: Nonlinear Inverse Theory**, taken at the University of British Columbia. Portions of the template code originate from the course instructor, Prof. Eldad Haber, while I have added my own numerical experiments and examples explored as part of self-study on the topics.
